model_annotation: Figure 1, titled "Entwicklung der Aluminium-, Kupfer- und Nickel-Importe aus Russland," presents the development of aluminum, copper, and nickel imports from Russia for both Germany and the EU. The figure consists of two grouped bar charts, with the left chart representing Germany and the right chart representing the EU. The horizontal axis lists the three metals: aluminum, copper, and nickel, while the vertical axis represents the percentage, ranging from 0 to 30% with a linear scale and tick labels at intervals of 5%. Each metal has three bars corresponding to the years 2021, 2022, and 2023, colored blue, pink, and gray, respectively. For Germany, the approximate percentages for aluminum are 3.6% in 2021, 2.7% in 2022, and 1.0% in 2023; for copper, they are 8.3% in 2021, 11.3% in 2022, and 2.2% in 2023; and for nickel, they are 25.1% in 2021, 24.7% in 2022, and 11.4% in 2023. For the EU, the approximate percentages for aluminum are 3.2% in 2021, 2.8% in 2022, and 1.7% in 2023; for copper, they are 4.4% in 2021, 5.1% in 2022, and 1.3% in 2023; and for nickel, they are 24.3% in 2021, 23.3% in 2022, and 14.6% in 2023. The bars are grouped by metal, with the three years clustered together for each metal. The data source is listed as "Trade Map (ITC), Juli 2024."
